cases.task: Browse the database for available biological information of different organism.
cases.expected: The user should be able to view a list of organisms with corresponding biological information without any missing data or display errors.

cases.task: Search for a organism by part of its name, then search for a word that appears only in a habitat or description (for example the habitat name).
cases.expected: The name search returns only the matching organisms; the habitat/description word returns no results, because the search now matches the organisms name only.

cases.task: Apply a filter to the data based on a given criterion (e.g., habitat type).
cases.expected: The data should update to show only those entries that meet the filter criteria, without displaying entries that do not match.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'honeydew' as the background color and 'dark olive green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'honeydew' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark olive green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

cases.task: Open every main page (browse list, search results, filter area, detail pages) and read all visible text, navigation labels, headings, buttons and messages.
cases.expected: The word 'species' (and its plural) no longer appears anywhere; the concept is called 'organism' everywhere (navigation, headings, buttons, messages), and the pages still work.
